app.name: Balligh
app.tagline: From the source to a lesson in your language

testdata: Test data: this lesson comes from a neutral test source. It is not reviewed religious or scholarly content.

start.title: Prepare a short lesson from a known source
start.body: Choose a known Arabic source and a lesson language, generate a draft, compare every card with its source sentence, acknowledge the version you checked, then preview and export it.

setup.title: Prepare a lesson
setup.noFixture: There is no hand-written test draft for this source, language and level.
setup.generateOff: Generation is not set up on this computer. Add DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to app\.env, then restart the server.
setup.current: You have a draft in progress
setup.sourceHelp: Each draft is written from one registered source. Its text is shown exactly as stored.
setup.localeHelp: The draft is written in this language. Machine translation stays unreviewed until a person checks it.
setup.generateHint: DeepSeek writes three cards, a few terms and one question from this source only. The result is an unreviewed AI draft: compare every card with its source sentence.
setup.previewFailed: The source text could not be loaded. Generation stays off until it loads.
setup.previewUnavailable: The server's copy of this source does not match the selected version, or it has no local text. Reload the page before generating.
setup.generateWait: Generation becomes available once the selected source text has loaded and matches the selected source.

level.detailedHelp: A fuller explanation that spells out conditions and exceptions.

review.title: Local review
review.ackConfirm: I compared this version with the source
review.ackHelp: This is a local acknowledgment. It is not a verified identity, an institutional approval, or a scholarly review.
review.staleHelp: The meaning-bearing content changed after the acknowledgment. Check it and acknowledge again.
review.ackDisabled: Acknowledgment becomes available once the current version passes validation.
review.originalFailed: The original text could not be loaded.
review.originalUnavailable: The registered source text does not match the version this draft cites, so it is not shown.
review.emptyField: This field is empty. Add text before acknowledging or exporting the lesson.
review.termsHelp: Edit how each term is shown and explained. The Arabic form stays exactly as it appears in the source.
review.termDisplay: Term as shown in the lesson
review.optionsHelp: Edit the wording of each choice and mark the one the source supports. Choices cannot be added or removed here.
review.rationale: Why it is correct (shown to the learner)
review.structureHelp: The server could not accept this version as a lesson. Each line names the field and the rule it breaks; fix the field and the check runs again.
review.registryHelp: These checks compare the lesson with the registered source: every quoted passage must match the stored text and its fingerprint, no text may be blank, and the test status and origin must agree with the registry. Passing them does not show that a sentence supports an explanation; that stays your comparison.
review.confirmReset: The lesson changed after you confirmed the comparison. Compare this version with the source and confirm again.
review.ackSuperseded: The lesson changed while your acknowledgment was being recorded, so it was not applied. Compare the current version and confirm again.

status.unverified: Not verified — the check did not succeed

preview.title: Lesson preview
preview.listenOff: Lesson audio is not available: Balligh does not generate narration of lesson or source text.
preview.wrong: Not quite. Read the source passage this question is based on, then try again. Wrong attempts are not counted against you.
preview.empty: No lesson is open. Start from setup.
preview.aiDraft: AI draft: the translation and explanations were written by a model and have not been reviewed by a person.

import.done: Imported. The lesson starts as a draft: any approval claimed in the file was ignored, so acknowledge again if you agree with it.
import.tooBig: The file is larger than 2 MiB.
import.unreadable: The file could not be read.
import.superseded: The import was not applied because the open work changed while the file was being checked. Import the file again if you still need it.
import.kept: Import cancelled. The open lesson, its acknowledgment and the learner's progress are unchanged.
import.confirmBody: The file «{{incoming}}» passed the checks. Importing it replaces «{{current}}», clears its acknowledgment and restarts the learner's progress. Export the open lesson first if you want to keep it.

error.network: The local server is not reachable. Your edits stay open in this tab.
error.generic: That did not work: {{message}}. Your work is unchanged.

sourcesPage.title: Sources and limitations
sourcesPage.localeNote: Interface readiness is technical. "Generation tested" means at least one recorded live draft in that language passed the app's checks; it is not a content review. No language has reviewed content.
sourcesPage.limit1: Lesson drafts are generated by DeepSeek from registered sources. They stay unreviewed AI drafts until a person checks them.
sourcesPage.limit2: Audio: only the recorded Quran recitation in the library. There is no generated narration of lessons, fatwas or hadith.
sourcesPage.limit3: Acknowledgment is local and self-declared. It is not an institutional or scholarly approval.
sourcesPage.limit4: The official scholarly content package and content reviewers are not confirmed yet.
sourcesPage.limit5: Work is saved only in this browser. It is not synced or backed up.
sourcesPage.limit6: Interface translations other than Arabic and English are machine-drafted and unreviewed.

storage.note: Work in progress is saved in this browser only.
storage.saveFailed: Local saving failed. Your latest changes are NOT saved in this browser. Export JSON to keep a copy.
storage.recoveryTitle: Saved work could not be read
storage.recoveryBody: The data stored in this browser could not be used ({{reason}}). It has been left untouched, and nothing new is saved until you decide. Copy it below if you need it, then discard it to resume saving.
storage.reset: Discard stored data and resume saving
storage.unavailableTitle: Saved work could not be checked
storage.unavailableBody: This browser did not let the app read its saved data ({{reason}}). Whether earlier work exists is unknown, so nothing is saved automatically until you decide. Reload to check again (unsaved work in this tab will be lost), or discard the stored data and resume saving.
storage.pausedWarning: Saving is paused: your current work is open in this tab but is NOT saved in this browser. Export JSON to keep a copy.
storage.resetFailed: Discarding the stored data failed, so nothing was changed and saving is still paused.

gen.workingHelp: This usually takes one to two minutes. Keep this page open; leaving it cancels the request.
gen.cancelled: Generation cancelled. Your current work is unchanged. The provider may still count a cancelled request.
gen.discarded: The new draft was not applied because your work changed while it was being written.
gen.replaceBody: «{{title}}» is open. The new draft replaces it once it is ready, and its acknowledgment is cleared. Export the current draft first if you want to keep it.
gen.ready: Draft ready. Compare each card with its source sentence before acknowledging it.

error.not_configured: Generation is not set up on this computer. Add DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to app\.env, then restart the server.
error.busy: Two drafts are already being generated. Try again in a moment.
error.stale_source: The source changed on the server. Reload the page and try again.
error.unsupported: This source or language cannot be used for generation.
error.provider_auth: DeepSeek rejected the key. Check DEEPSEEK_API_KEY in app\.env and restart the server.
error.provider_balance: The DeepSeek account has no available balance.
error.provider_busy: DeepSeek is busy right now. Try again in a minute.
error.provider_timeout: DeepSeek did not finish in time. You can try again; the provider may still count the attempt.
error.provider_network: DeepSeek could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_output: The model's answer did not pass the lesson checks, so nothing was replaced.
error.insufficient_context: The model reported that this source is not enough for a full lesson. Nothing was replaced.
error.network: The local server could not be reached. Nothing was replaced.

origin.title: Draft origin
origin.fixture: Declared origin: test fixture. No verified provider record is attached, so this does not show whether an AI model was used.
origin.manual: Declared origin: manual. No verified provider record is attached, so this does not show whether an AI model was used.
origin.live: AI draft generated by {{provider}} ({{model}}). Not reviewed by a person.
origin.edited: Edited after it was created (as recorded in this draft).
origin.notEdited: No edits recorded since it was created.
origin.findingsHelp: Recorded by the app's checks when this draft was generated, for example a proposed term that was removed because its Arabic form is not in the source or the glossary. They describe what was changed or flagged; they are not a content review.

evidence.activityHelp: The registered passages this question cites, quoted exactly. Citing a passage does not prove that it supports the answer; check that yourself.
evidence.show: Highlight the evidence in the original
evidence.highlightedCard: Highlighted for the selected card: passage {{list}}
evidence.none: This question cites no registered passage.
evidence.sourceLevelHelp: Terms point to the whole source, not to a specific sentence.

export.requested: {{file}} was prepared and your browser was asked to download it. Check the browser's downloads to confirm it was saved.
export.changed: {{file}} was not downloaded because the lesson changed while it was being prepared. Export again to get the current version.

author.title: Author tools
author.help: Export, import or clear the lesson here. These tools leave the learner's progress alone unless the lesson itself changes.

learn.termsHelp: Open a term to see its meaning and where it comes from.
learn.complete: You have completed the three stations of this lesson.
learn.localNote: Progress records only what you did in this browser: marking the reading, opening terms and your answer. It is not a grade or a measure of learning, and it is not part of the exported file.
learn.resetFailed: The progress record could not be removed from this browser. Progress on this page was reset.

storage.saved: Progress is saved in this browser only.
storage.unavailable: This browser does not let the app save progress. It is kept only while this page is open.
storage.corrupt: Saved progress in this browser could not be read and was left untouched. Progress is kept only while this page is open until you reset it.
storage.write_failed: Progress could not be saved in this browser. It is kept only while this page is open.

learn.reviewNoticeAck: Acknowledged locally by {{label}}. This is a self-declared acknowledgment, not a verified identity or a scholarly review.
learn.reviewNoticeDraft: Technical preview: no one has acknowledged this version. Use it to check the lesson, not to teach from it.

example.confirmTitle: Replace the open lesson with the test draft?
example.confirmBody: Opening «{{incoming}}» replaces «{{current}}», clears its acknowledgment and restarts the learner's progress. Export the open lesson first if you want to keep it.
example.kept: The test draft was not opened. The open lesson, its acknowledgment and the learner's progress are unchanged.
example.superseded: The test draft was not opened because the open work changed while it was loading. Open it again if you still need it.

library.title: Library
library.intro: Read published Islamic sources in their original Arabic, with a translation where the publisher provides one.
library.notice: Texts are shown as their publishers released them.
library.readingLanguageHint: The Arabic original is always shown. A translation appears only where one is available.
library.statusNote: Source text as its publisher released it.
library.searchHint: Matches the words you type in titles, topics and references. It does not search the full text.
library.emptySearch: Nothing matches {{q}}. Try other words or clear the search.
library.emptyTopic: There are no entries under this topic.
library.availableIn: Reading languages available for this item: {{languages}}

quran.listError: Could not load the list of surahs.
quran.notDelivered: Surah {{number}} is not part of this library.
quran.arabicLabel: Arabic text of the Quran as provided by QuranEnc.
quran.originalOnly: Arabic is selected: the Quran is shown in its original Arabic, without a translation.
quran.translationUnavailable: No translation of the meanings in {{language}} is available here. Only the Arabic text is shown.
